note: Shared document corpus. Both runners index these documents, in this order, into two indexes: 'stop' (StandardTokenizer + lowercase + stop words, NO stemming) and 'standard' (the same pipeline plus a Porter-style stemmer). Text is deliberately restricted to ASCII letters and single spaces so that tokenizer differences cannot perturb the search comparison; tokenizer edge cases live in the analyzer case group instead.
